## 0.0 Introduction and Set-up

In this script I will perform an EWAS on the X and Y chromosome probes for eoPRED score in the 450K dataset.

```{r packages, warning=F, message=F}

library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(limma)
library(biobroom)
library(lumi)
library(cowplot)
library(ggrepel)
library(plyr)

#load the 450K probe information
probeInfo_450k <- as.data.frame(cbind(
  IlluminaHumanMethylation450kanno.ilmn12.hg19::Locations, 
  IlluminaHumanMethylation450kanno.ilmn12.hg19::Other, 
  IlluminaHumanMethylation450kanno.ilmn12.hg19::Manifest))
probeInfo_450k$probeID <-rownames(probeInfo_450k)

chrXprobes_450k <- probeInfo_450k %>% filter (chr == "chrX") 
chrYprobes_450k <- probeInfo_450k %>% filter (chr == "chrY") 
remove(probeInfo_450k)

set.seed(4815)
theme_set(theme_minimal())
theme_update(
  panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
  axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
  axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
  axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
  legend.position="none"
  )

```

### 0.2 Load Data

```{r data}

disc_pDat <- readRDS(here::here("02_Outputs/01_450K_Proc/pDat_filt.RDS"))
disc_betas <- readRDS(here::here("02_Outputs/01_450K_Proc/betas_adjdas_filt.RDS"))
dim(disc_pDat) #354 samples
dim(disc_betas) #x354

#Remove samples with chromosome abnormalities
disc_pDat <- disc_pDat %>% filter(!Sample_ID %in% c("GSM2589548","GSM2674422"))
dim(disc_pDat) #352

#If a sample has no reported gestational age use PlaNET RPC gestational age
disc_pDat <- disc_pDat %>%
  mutate(GA_harmonized = ifelse(is.na(GA), GA_RPC, GA))%>%
  mutate(Condition_new = case_when(
           Condition =="EOPE" ~ "EOPE",
           Condition =="LOPE" ~ "LOPE",
           Condition =="PE" & GA_harmonized<34 ~ "EOPE",
           Condition =="PE" & GA_harmonized>=34 ~ "LOPE",
           GA_harmonized<37 ~ "nPTB",
           GA_harmonized>=37 ~ "nTB")) 

#XX and XY metadata
disc_pDat_f <- disc_pDat %>% filter(DNAme_Sex == "XX")
disc_pDat_m <- disc_pDat %>% filter(DNAme_Sex == "XY")
nrow(disc_pDat_f) #169
nrow(disc_pDat_m) #183

#select the sex chromosomes
# X chr (XX) probes
betas_fx <- na.omit(disc_betas [rownames(disc_betas) %in% chrXprobes_450k$probeID, disc_pDat_f$Sample_ID])
mvals_fx <- lumi::beta2m(betas_fx)
dim(mvals_fx) #8895 x 169

# X chr (XY) probes
betas_mx <- na.omit(disc_betas [rownames(disc_betas) %in% chrXprobes_450k$probeID, disc_pDat_m$Sample_ID])
mvals_mx <- lumi::beta2m(betas_mx)
dim(mvals_mx) #8895 x 183

# Y chr probes
betas_my <- na.omit(disc_betas [rownames(disc_betas) %in% chrYprobes_450k$probeID, disc_pDat_m$Sample_ID])
mvals_my <- lumi::beta2m(betas_my)
dim(mvals_my) #226 x 183

```

In my linear models when I correct for cell-composition I will include Syncytiotrophoblasts, Stromal, Endothelial, and nRBC. I excluded Trophoblasts/Cytotrophoblast because it was highly correlated (R2 >= 0.80, cut-off based on PMID: 31304696) with the proportion of Syncytiotrophoblasts (made up the larger proportion of samples). Syncytiotrophoblasts were correlated with Stromal and Endothelial cell-proportions but not with a R^2 >= 0.80. I excluded Hofbauer because it made up less than 1% of most samples.


### 0.3 Linear Modelling Function

```{r lm-functions}

linear_modelling <- function(betas,mvals,model){
#run model on m values & calculate empirical Bayesian statistics
  fit<- lmFit(mvals, model) %>% eBayes()
  td <- biobroom::tidy.MArrayLM(fit)
  
  #calculate delta beta
  fit_B <- lmFit(betas, model) %>% eBayes()
  td <- td %>% mutate(delB =
                        (biobroom::tidy.MArrayLM(fit_B))$estimate)
  
  #calculate SE of regression coefficients
  se_coef <- sqrt(fit_B$s2.post) * fit_B$stdev.unscaled
  se_coef <- se_coef %>% as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column(var="probeID") %>%
    pivot_longer(-"probeID", names_to= "term", values_to="se")
  
  #multiple test correct
  td <- td %>% 
    dplyr::rename(probeID = gene) %>% #biobroom assumes tested genes, not CpGs, rename
    group_by(term) %>%
    mutate(fdr = p.adjust(p.value, method="fdr")) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    as.data.frame()
  
  td <- td %>%
    left_join(se_coef, by=c("probeID" = "probeID", "term"="term")) %>%
    mutate(ConfInt_95 = delB + 1.96*se,
           ConfInt_5 = delB - 1.96*se)
  return(td)
}

lm_significant_hits <- function(td){
#significant hits 
sig_hits <- matrix(c(
  nrow(td %>% filter(fdr<0.05)),
  nrow(td %>% filter(fdr<0.05 & abs(delB) > 0.05)),
  nrow(td %>% filter(fdr<0.05 & abs(delB) > 0.1)),
  nrow(td %>% filter(fdr<0.05 & abs(delB) > 0.25)),
  nrow(td %>% filter(fdr<0.05 & abs(delB) > 0.5)),
  nrow(td %>% filter(fdr<0.01)),
  nrow(td %>% filter(fdr<0.01 & abs(delB) > 0.05)),
  nrow(td %>% filter(fdr<0.01 & abs(delB) > 0.1)),
  nrow(td %>% filter(fdr<0.01 & abs(delB) > 0.25)),
  nrow(td %>% filter(fdr<0.01 & abs(delB) > 0.5))
  ),ncol=2)

colnames(sig_hits) <- c("FDR < 0.05", "FDR < 0.01")
rownames(sig_hits) <- c("delB >0", "delB >0.05", "delB >0.1", "delB >0.25", "delB >0.5")
sig_hits <-as.table(sig_hits)

return(sig_hits)
}

```

## 1.0 Linear Models

### 1.1 EOPE vs. nPTB

```{r eope-nptb-fx}

disc_pDat_f_select <- disc_pDat_f %>%
  filter(Condition_new %in% c("EOPE","nPTB")) %>%
  mutate(Condition_new = factor(Condition_new, levels=c("nPTB","EOPE")))
table(disc_pDat_f_select$Condition_new)

betas_fx_select <- betas_fx [, disc_pDat_f_select$Sample_ID]
dim(betas_fx_select)
mvals_fx_select <- mvals_fx [, disc_pDat_f_select$Sample_ID]
dim(mvals_fx_select)


mod_eope1_fx <- model.matrix(~ Condition_new+GEO_Dataset+GA_harmonized+
                                 Prob_Caucasian+Prob_African,disc_pDat_f_select, row.names=T)
mod_eope2_fx <- model.matrix(~ Condition_new+GEO_Dataset+GA_harmonized+
                                 Prob_Caucasian+Prob_African+Syncytiotrophoblast+
                                   Stromal+Endothelial+nRBC, disc_pDat_f_select,row.names=T)

head(mod_eope1_fx) #check

lm_eope1_fx <-linear_modelling (betas_fx_select, mvals_fx_select, mod_eope1_fx) %>% filter (term == "Condition_newEOPE")
lm_eope2_fx <-linear_modelling (betas_fx_select, mvals_fx_select, mod_eope2_fx) %>% filter (term == "Condition_newEOPE")

head(lm_eope1_fx) #check

#hits?
lm_significant_hits(lm_eope1_fx)
lm_significant_hits(lm_eope2_fx)

```

### 1.2 eoPRED score

i) DNAme ~ eoPRED score + GEO Dataset
ii) DNAme ~ eoPRED score + GEO Dataset + GA + ancestry
iii) DNAme ~ eoPRED score + GEO Dataset + GA + ancestry + cell composition

When reported GA is missing use PlaNET GA. I used `Prob_Caucasian` and `Prob_African` to match what I did in SPAH (but using any two of the three estimates shouldn't make a difference). I coded `GEO_Dataset` as categorical rather than a dummy numeric variable because I thought this was more appropriate - we wanted to identify dataset independent hits.

```{r eopred-fx}

mod_eopred1_fx <- model.matrix(~ EOPE+GEO_Dataset, disc_pDat_f,row.names=T)
mod_eopred2_fx <- model.matrix(~ EOPE+GEO_Dataset+GA_harmonized+
                                 Prob_Caucasian+Prob_African, disc_pDat_f,row.names=T)
mod_eopred3_fx <- model.matrix(~ EOPE+GEO_Dataset+GA_harmonized+
                                 Prob_Caucasian+Prob_African+Syncytiotrophoblast+
                                   Stromal+Endothelial+nRBC, disc_pDat_f,row.names=T)

head(mod_eopred3_fx) #check

lm_eopred1_fx <-linear_modelling (betas_fx,mvals_fx,mod_eopred1_fx) %>% filter (term == "EOPE")
lm_eopred2_fx <-linear_modelling (betas_fx,mvals_fx,mod_eopred2_fx) %>% filter (term == "EOPE")
lm_eopred3_fx <-linear_modelling (betas_fx,mvals_fx,mod_eopred3_fx) %>% filter (term == "EOPE")

head(lm_eopred2_fx) #check

#hits?
lm_significant_hits(lm_eopred1_fx)
lm_significant_hits(lm_eopred2_fx)
lm_significant_hits(lm_eopred3_fx)

```


## 2.0 Plots

### 2.1 EOPE vs. nPTB

```{r eope-vps}

eope_plot_fx <- lm_eope1_fx %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=delB, y=-log10(fdr), color=case_when(
    fdr < 0.05 & abs(delB) > 0.1 ~ "DMC",
    fdr < 0.05 ~ "FDR<0.05",
    .default = "Not Significant"))) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.8, size=2.25)+
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), color="grey33", linetype="dashed")+
  geom_vline(xintercept=c(-0.1,0.1), color="grey33", linetype="dashed")+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("DMC" ="black","FDR<0.05" ="grey55","Not Significant" ="grey88"))+
  labs(x=expression(paste(Delta*beta, " EOPE-nPTB")),y="-log(FDR)",color="",
       title = "X chr (XX)")+
  theme(legend.position="none",
        plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5, size = 14, face ="bold"),
        axis.title = element_text(size=14),
        axis.text = element_text(size=12),
        legend.title = element_text(size=12),
        legend.text = element_text(size=10))+
  geom_text_repel(data=(lm_eope1_fx %>% filter(fdr< 0.05 & abs(delB)>0.1)),
                  aes(x=delB, y=-log10(fdr), label=probeID),
  show.legend=F, max.overlaps = Inf, size=4, min.segment.length=0)+
  ylim(0,3.5)

eope_plot_mx <- lm_eope1_mx %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=delB, y=-log10(fdr), color=case_when(
    fdr < 0.05 & abs(delB) > 0.1 ~ "DMC",
    fdr < 0.05 ~ "FDR<0.05",
    .default = "Not Significant"))) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.8, size=2.25)+
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), color="grey33", linetype="dashed")+
  geom_vline(xintercept=c(-0.1,0.1), color="grey33", linetype="dashed")+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("DMC" ="black","FDR<0.05" ="grey55","Not Significant" ="grey88"))+
  labs(x=expression(paste(Delta*beta, " EOPE-nPTB")),y="-log(FDR)",color="",
       title = "X chr (XY)")+
  theme(legend.position="none",
        plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5, size = 14, face ="bold"),
        axis.title = element_text(size=14),
        axis.text = element_text(size=12),
        legend.title = element_text(size=12),
        legend.text = element_text(size=10))+
  geom_text_repel(data=(lm_eope1_mx %>% filter(fdr< 0.05 & abs(delB)>0.1)),
                  aes(x=delB, y=-log10(fdr), label=probeID),
  show.legend=F, max.overlaps = Inf, size=4, min.segment.length=0)+
  ylim(0,3.5)

eope_plot_my <- lm_eope1_my %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=delB, y=-log10(fdr), color=case_when(
    fdr < 0.05 & abs(delB) > 0.1 ~ "DMC",
    fdr < 0.05 ~ "FDR<0.05",
    .default = "Not Significant"))) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.8, size=2.25)+
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), color="grey33", linetype="dashed")+
  geom_vline(xintercept=c(-0.1,0.1), color="grey33", linetype="dashed")+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("DMC" ="black","FDR<0.05" ="grey55","Not Significant" ="grey88"))+
  labs(x=expression(paste(Delta*beta, " EOPE-nPTB")),y="-log(FDR)",color="",
       title = "Y chr (XY)")+
  theme(legend.position="none",legend.background=element_blank(),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.5,'cm'), legend.key.width = unit(0.3,'cm'),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5, size = 14, face ="bold"),
        axis.title = element_text(size=14),
        axis.text = element_text(size=12),
        legend.title = element_text(size=12),
        legend.text = element_text(size=10))+
  # geom_text_repel(data=(lm_eope1_my %>% filter(fdr< 0.05 & abs(delB)>0.1)),
  #                 aes(x=delB, y=-log10(fdr), label=probeID),
  # show.legend=F, max.overlaps = Inf, size=3, min.segment.length=0)+
  ylim(0,3.5)

eope_vps <- plot_grid(NULL, NULL, NULL,
                        eope_plot_fx, eope_plot_mx, eope_plot_my,
                        nrow=2, rel_heights=c(0.075,1))
eope_vps

ggsave("EOPE_volcano_plots.png", plot = eope_vps, path = here::here("02_Outputs/04_450K_EWAS"), width = 12, height =6, device = "png")
saveRDS(eope_vps, here::here("02_Outputs/04_450K_EWAS/450K_volcanoplots.rds"))
```

### 2.2 eoPRED score

```{r eopred-vps}

eopred_plot_fx <- lm_eopred2_fx %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=delB, y=-log10(fdr), color=case_when(
```

## 3.0 Hits

### 3.1 EOPE vs. nPTB
```{r eope-hits}

eope_hits_fx <- lm_eope1_fx %>% filter(fdr<0.05 & abs(delB)>0.1) %>% left_join(chrXprobes_450k)
dim(eope_hits_fx) #4
eope_hits_fx$probeID #"cg07344627" "cg07648454" "cg07994386" "cg20569128"

eope_hits_mx <- lm_eope1_mx %>% filter(fdr<0.05 & abs(delB)>0.1) %>% left_join(chrXprobes_450k)
dim(eope_hits_mx) #2
eope_hits_mx$probeID #"cg19022384" "cg24268343"

lm_eope2_mx %>% filter(fdr<0.05 & abs(delB)>0.1) #same probes

#combine XX and XY information
colnames(lm_eope1_fx) <- paste0(colnames(lm_eope1_fx),"_f")
colnames(lm_eope1_fx)
lm_eope1_x <- lm_eope1_mx %>% left_join(lm_eope1_fx, by=c("probeID"="probeID_f"))
dim(lm_eope1_x) #9210 x 21

#what do the hits look like in the other sex
lm_eope1_x %>% 
  filter(probeID %in% c(eope_hits_mx$probeID, eope_hits_fx$probeID)) %>%
  dplyr::select(probeID, delB, p.value, fdr, delB_f, p.value_f, fdr_f)

#identify which probes do not have overlapping delta-beta 95% CIs
#identify if the probes have regression coefficients in the same direction
lm_eope1_x <- lm_eope1_x %>%
  mutate(Overlap_CI = case_when(
    ConfInt_95_f < ConfInt_5 ~ F,
    ConfInt_5_f > ConfInt_95 ~ F,
    .default = T),
    Same_Direction_CI = sign(delB) == sign(delB_f))

table(lm_eope1_x$Overlap_CI) #512 FALSE

#classify the hits using the criteria
eope_hits_x <- lm_eope1_x %>%
  filter(probeID %in% c(eope_hits_mx$probeID, eope_hits_fx$probeID)) %>%
 mutate(Sex_specific_call = 
           ifelse(probeID %in% eope_hits_mx$probeID,
             case_when(
               Overlap_CI==F & p.value_f>=0.05 ~ "Sex Specific",
               Overlap_CI==F & p.value_f<0.05 & Same_Direction_CI==T ~ "Sex Differential",
               Overlap_CI==F & p.value_f<0.05 & Same_Direction_CI==F ~ "Sex Opposite",
               Overlap_CI==T & p.value_f<0.05 ~ "Association in both sexes",
               Overlap_CI==T & p.value_f>=0.05 ~ "Association in one sex"),
             case_when(
               Overlap_CI==F & p.value>=0.05 ~ "Sex Specific",
               Overlap_CI==F & p.value<0.05 & Same_Direction_CI==T ~ "Sex Differential",
               Overlap_CI==F & p.value<0.05 & Same_Direction_CI==F ~ "Sex Opposite",
               Overlap_CI==T & p.value<0.05 ~ "Association in both sexes",
               Overlap_CI==T & p.value>=0.05 ~ "Association in one sex")))
table(eope_hits_x$Sex_specific_call, eope_hits_x$probeID)

eope_hits_x %>% dplyr::select(Sex_specific_call, ConfInt_95, ConfInt_5, ConfInt_95_f, ConfInt_5_f)

```

```{r eope-hits-save}

lm_eope1_x_save <- eope_hits_x %>%
  left_join((chrXprobes_450k %>% dplyr::select(probeID, chr,pos, UCSC_RefGene_Name,
                                               UCSC_RefGene_Group)))%>%
  dplyr::select(probeID, p.value, fdr, delB, ConfInt_5, ConfInt_95,
                p.value_f, fdr_f, delB_f, ConfInt_5_f, ConfInt_95_f,
                Overlap_CI, Same_Direction_CI, Sex_specific_call, chr, pos, UCSC_RefGene_Name,
                UCSC_RefGene_Group) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    XY_pval = p.value,
    XY_fdr = fdr,
    XY_delB = delB,
    XY_lowCI = ConfInt_5,
    XY_highCI = ConfInt_95,
    XX_pval = p.value_f,
    XX_fdr = fdr_f,
    XX_delB = delB_f,
    XX_lowCI = ConfInt_5_f,
    XX_highCI = ConfInt_95_f
  ) 

```

Run the linear model on the X chromosome hits in all samples and test to see if the interaction term is significant for the hits (testing for sex-specific and sex-differential effects).

```{r sex-specific-test}

head(mod_eope_x_hits)

lm_eope_x_hits

               dplyr::select(probeID, delB, p.value, fdr) %>%
               dplyr::rename(Int_delB = delB,
                             Int_pval = p.value,

lm_eope1_x_save %>%
  dplyr::select(probeID, Int_fdr, Sex_specific_call)
```

### 3.2 eoPRED score

What are the probes associated with eoPRED score> (q-value<0.25 and |delta-beta|>0.25)?

Compare the X chromosome hits between XX and XY samples:

1) Do the regression coefficient 95% confidence intervals overlap between groups?
2) Do the regression coefficient 95% confidence intervals overlap 0 in either group?
3) Are the regression coefficient 95% confidence intervals in the same direction?

```{r eopred-hits}

eopred_hits_my %>% dplyr::select(probeID, fdr, delB, pos, UCSC_RefGene_Name) 

#combine XX and XY information
colnames(lm_eopred2_fx) <- paste0(colnames(lm_eopred2_fx),"_f")
colnames(lm_eopred2_fx)
lm_eopred2_x <- lm_eopred2_mx %>% left_join(lm_eopred2_fx, by=c("probeID"="probeID_f"))
dim(lm_eopred2_x) #8895 x 21

#what do the hits look like in the other sex
lm_eopred2_x %>% 
  filter(probeID %in% c(eopred_hits_mx$probeID, eopred_hits_fx$probeID)) %>%
  dplyr::select(probeID, delB, p.value, fdr, delB_f, p.value_f, fdr_f)

#identify which probes do not have overlapping delta-beta 95% CIs
#identify if the probes have regression coefficients in the same direction
lm_eopred2_x <- lm_eopred2_x %>%
  mutate(Overlap_CI = case_when(
    ConfInt_95_f < ConfInt_5 ~ F,
    ConfInt_5_f > ConfInt_95 ~ F,
    .default = T),
    Same_Direction_CI = sign(delB) == sign(delB_f))

table(lm_eopred2_x$Overlap_CI) #313 FALSE

#classify the hits using the criteria
eopred_hits_x <- lm_eopred2_x %>%
  filter(probeID %in% c(eopred_hits_mx$probeID, eopred_hits_fx$probeID)) %>%
 mutate(Sex_specific_call =

             case_when(
               Overlap_CI==F & p.value>=0.05 ~ "Sex Specific",
               Overlap_CI==F & p.value<0.05 & Same_Direction_CI==T ~ "Sex Differential",
               Overlap_CI==F & p.value<0.05 & Same_Direction_CI==F ~ "Sex Opposite",
```
